snippet.title: TSURUGIHIME | Official Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
👇️ Add to your Wishlist!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2220860/

----------

Latest gameplay footage of the upcoming brand new indie game "TSURUGIHIME" created by 213℉!

⚔️ What is "TSURUGIHIME"
The last battle is in 100 days and it is up to the player how to live those days. Built upon the classic genre, side scrolling action RPG, you can "craft" anything from battles, customizing, exploration, story and even your "sister." This is An RPG that "crafts" fate. This is the first game from the former creative producer of "Fate/Grand Order, Yosuke Shiokawa  since becoming independent. Together with character designer KUROBOSHI KOUHAKU and composer Takeharu Ishimoto.

⚔️ "TSURUGIHIME" Overview
Title: TSURUGIHIME
Genre: An RPG that "crafts" fate.
Platform: Steam®
Release Date: 2026 (Early Access planned)
Number of Players: Single Player
Languages: English / Japanese / Simplified Chinese
Developer/Publisher: 213℉
Team Member:
Director Yosuke Shiokawa
Character Design KUROBOSHI KOUHAKU
Composer Takeharu Ishimoto
Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2220860/
Official Discord Server：https://discord.gg/hSC8dgfkaz

*The game is currently under development and subject to change.
